name: Eney
notes: Eney is MacPaw's AI assistant for Mac. It works across apps and connectors (Notion, Linear, Google Docs/Drive) to draft emails, take meeting notes, handle files and media, and suggest next steps proactively. Requested via the form (issue #213).
tagline: Proactive AI assistant designed to fix scattered work

access.price: Free credits included · Starter $18/mo · Boost $36/mo · Power $60/mo; also on Setapp
